neighbours.label: a plural or collective noun naming a group or institution being referred to (the doctors, universities, institutions, the village of)
fire: The eMedicine doctors answer questions about cholesterol in children.
Residents of the Yorkshire village of Marsden saw a strange light.
Several large universities have joined the research programme.
Public institutions must publish their accounts every year.
The senior physicians proposed new guidelines for diabetes care.
A small hamlet near the border was cut off by the snow.
Most of the hospitals in the region were short of nurses.
The colleges announced the winners of the design challenge.
quiet: The website answers questions about cholesterol in children.
Residents reported that they saw a strange light over Marsden.
Several large grants have joined the research programme.
Every year, accounts must be published in full.
The new guidelines for diabetes care were proposed last spring.
A narrow road near the border was cut off by the snow.
Most of the winter in the region was short of rain.
The jury announced the winners of the design challenge.

notes: card: low max (4.5); peaks on ' village' x5, 'stitutions' x3, Doctors, Universities, house. The + pole is ' local' in 'your local hospital'. Near misses use individual or abstract nouns in the same frames.
